thread:
maya: Repro report: customer A and B hit duplicated token charges on resumed streaming after client-side split + server truncation. Seen with prefetch enabled and qat8 codec.

maya: Short repro: client streams, server prefetch writes a provisional prefix claim, client splits (sends resume token), router hands to new host, new host asks for resume snapshot, server truncates prefix and replays suffix -> ledger ends up with provisional prefix + confirmed suffix overlap.

maya: snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-21T08:14:02Z] session=xyz prefetch=1 codec=qat8 recv=1024 truncate=720 provisional_id=pfx-xyz tokens=720
[2026-03-21T08:14:02Z] handoff from eu-west -> us-east new_session=uvw resume_token=rtk-555
[2026-03-21T08:14:03Z] resume applied suffix=304 confirmed_id=cfm-uvw tokens=304 parent=pfx-xyz
```

sam: Are confirmed entries referencing the same token indexes as provisional? or are we accidentally double-counting overlapping ranges? :anguished:

maya: Overlap. Provisional covers 1..720, confirmed covers 417..720 (suffix), so 304 tokens overlap. Billing snapshot shows both.

jin: Proposed fix: session_anchor GUID on provisional entries + include anchor in /internal/hand_off RPC so ledger can atomically reconcile. Sketch of handshake:
POST /internal/hand_off
{ "from_session":"xyz", "to_session":"uvw", "anchor_id":"anchor-20260321-e9", "overlap_hint":[417,720] }
Ledger commit will attempt to merge provisional entries with confirmed resume by anchor_id and remove duplicate token ranges.

ana: UX ask: expose provisional vs confirmed counts in Console Token Breakdown per-route and in the incident UI. If ops can filter by anchor_id or resume events it will save paging SRE at 02:00.

leo: telemetry: emit 'stream.resume.truncation' event with fields ["anchor_id","overlap_tokens","prefetch","codec","from_region","to_region","customer_id"]. Add rate alarm when duplicate-token-rate > 0.5% across prod.

sam: Tool-call nuance: if a tool is invoked after provisional claim but before reconcile, tool tokens are currently attached to the new session and not moved back -> potential duplicate or orphan. Ledger change needs to support moving child entries atomically when anchor resolves.

jin: Implementation notes:
- Add anchor_id column (nullable) to provisional_entries table.
- On handoff, router includes anchor_id. If anchor present, ledger writer will attempt a transactional dedupe using interval arithmetic (merge intervals, drop overlapping provisional).
- For toolcalls: store toolcall.parent_provisional_id so we can reparent when commit happens.
- Add concurrency tests + small chaos fuzzer for concurrent handoffs.

maya: Short-term mitigation options discussed:
- TTL for provisional entries (e.g., 2s): reduces window but risks under-billing for slow paths. Should be a customer-level flag.
- Conservative resume: new host requests a provisional reconcile API before applying snapshot and the original router can confirm/merge. Extra roundtrip but safe.

sam: TTL acceptable as emergency kill-switch behind feature flag. Long-term: anchor handshake + ledger dedupe is the plan. Jin to open PR with tests.

ops-bot: NOTE: created ENGPLAT-1289 (investigate stream resume double-charge). Assigned to jin, sam.

maya: I'll upload trace bundles to repro bucket and tag ENGPLAT-1289. Also will add sample Support transcripts showing paging incidents.

ana: I'll mock the console columns tomorrow AM (provisional_count, confirmed_count, overlap_flag). Sam/leo I'll loop in for telemetry and dashboard queries.

jin: I'll draft DB migration + PR. Will include unit tests for: overlapping intervals, reparenting toolcall rows, and transactional dedupe under concurrent handoffs.

sam: Thanks all. Follow-up meeting tomorrow 9:30 PT to choose mitigation rollout plan and flag default. :white_check_mark:
